purpose: Shared design and implementation boundary for Claude Fable and GPT

canonical_copy.citation_located: Source passage located. Confirm its meaning.
canonical_copy.no_detected_blockers_pending_human_revie: No blockers detected. Estimator review required.

field_location_contract.offset_unit: Unicode code points in line body after prefix

invariants: Clarification approval never resolves engineering blockers or automatically makes a quote ready.
The backend owns authoritative state and allowed actions; UI renders state and invokes callbacks.
Verbatim citation location checks do not establish semantic support.
Human review is required for every packet, including no detected blockers.
Extraction corrections or reruns invalidate old drafts and approvals.
Approval atomically saves the reviewed edited text with expected run and draft versions.
Synthetic previews and recorded execution must be visibly identified.
Expected fixture answers never enter a model request.
No invented results, confidence percentages, customer evidence, or measured ROI.
No credentials, internal JSON, or model settings in the normal estimator workflow.
integration_order: GPT creates typed props and callback signatures from this contract.
Claude Fable designs components and states against that interface while GPT implements backend logic.
GPT connects services and authoritative state to the presentational components.
Both check wording, action availability, evidence display, keyboard use, and the blocked approval case together.
